scientific_integrity: The all-length result is proved by BEST/matrix-tree factorial formulas, an exact three-vertex support classification and an explicit coefficientwise nonnegativity lemma; finite computation independently checks the derived statement and is not treated as its proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three labeled letters, cyclic order-two Markov profiles, and uniqueness modulo rotation. No claim about noisy reads, other alphabets or higher-order profiles; historical priority may be affected by unindexed earlier tables.
title: Quasipolynomial census of uniquely reconstructible ternary cyclic Markov profiles
